svg.title: A dot mandala on paper in five pictures. 1: a light guide circle and spokes, and a big magenta dot in the center. 2: a ring of 8 orange dots close to the center, one on each spoke. 3: 8 purple petals between the spokes, dragged outward from a dot. 4: a ring of big teal dots at the petal tips, small magenta dots on the spokes and an outer ring of tiny orange dots. Done: a trail of three teal dots, big to tiny, on each petal line, and white highlight dots.
